meta.source_title: Numbeo cost of living — Mumbai (updated 11 Oct 2026, 1,870 entries)
meta.note: Secondary source. HCES 2023-24 (MoSPI) gives Maharashtra urban average MPCE Rs 7,363/person/month (Rs ~353k/year for four people) but no Mumbai or family-of-four category cut; the Numbeo middle-class family-of-four basket (Rs 131,935.8/month excl. rent) plus 3-bedroom rent was used instead and is roughly 7x the HCES population average. Lower confidence.
